name: CQUniCares Emergency Grant
summary: Urgent financial help for CQUniversity students hit by unforeseen circumstances or an emergency.
who: In genuine need of urgent financial help because of unforeseen circumstances or an emergency
Enrolled and actively studying at CQUniversity
Completed at least one term of study at CQUniversity
Australian or New Zealand citizen, permanent resident or humanitarian visa holder
No Emergency Grant received in the last twelve months
how: Complete the CQU Cares Emergency Grant Application Form with a personal statement
Email the form and supporting documents to the Student Scholarships team

evidence.quote: Be in genuine need of urgent financial assistance as a result of unforeseen circumstances or an emergency situation
Have successfully completed at least one term of study at CQUniversity.
